newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel slips with NYMEX, buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel slips with NYMEX, buyers scarce.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices slipped between 1.10 cents and 1.30 cents with NYMEX futures on Wednesday, players said, with buyers holding out for lower prices.
Gulf Coast prompt back 30th cycle 54-grade fuel was offered 2.75 cents below November futures, unchanged from Tuesday differentials.
But Gulf buyers and sellers were a half cent apart on 31st cycle 54-grade, traders said, with offers at 1.75 cents below the December print but buyers at 2.50 cents under.
"With futures prices coming off over a penny today, sellers are thinking buyers won't be watching the diffs so much, but buyers aren't budging," one Gulf trader said.
New York 54-grade was pegged at about 1.0 cent over November futures, stable with Tuesday diffs, players said.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
